title: Slavey - Wikipedia
text: The Slavey (also Awokanak, Slave, and South Slavey) are a First Nations group of Indigenous peoples in Canada. They speak the Slavey language, a part of the Athabaskan languages.

title: Athabaskan languages - Wikipedia
text: Athabaskan, also known as Dene, is a large branch of the Na-Dene language family of North America, located in western North America in three areal language groups: Northern, Pacific Coast and Southern.

title: Slavey, North Language (SCS) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ...
text: North Slavey is an endangered indigenous language of Canada. It belongs to the Eyak-Athabaskan language family and is part of the Slave macrolanguage. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
